title: Misteriosa Luxury Soy Candle 850 gr
body_html:
Misteriosa Crystal Vase is made of mouth-blown crystal. The design pattern is engraved meticulously by our craftspeople using various techniques. The artwork then turned into a masterpiece by shaping the glass rim. Misteriosa Crystal Vase is then being hand painted with 24k gold and platinum and fired.

Each Leone di Fiume product, which combines the "crystal", which is the clearest and most perfect state of glass, and the "blowing" technique, which is the highest level of this art, is handmade by masters who have set their heart on this art.

This design is inspired by a door of a historical building. The engravings on the door turn it into an art. Doors that secretly or explicitly symbolize different beliefs in many cultures, have an important and meaningful place in all religions. Door figures are used as symbols for the passages to heaven and hell.

Misteriosa Crystal Vase is home to 100% soy wax and Leone di Fiume's signature perfume unique to this product.

The exquisite work of art is presented in a luxuriant handmade wooden chest.

Scent Profile

A highly luxurious harmony of cedarwood, cardamom and bergamot are blended seamlessly to create an intoxicating scent that is long lasting. The base notes of amber, musk and black pepper create a serene atmosphere with a spicy and pungent effect.

This design was inspired by horoscopes and Atlas, who carries humanity's all burdens on his shoulders. In Greek mythology, the human children of the Gods were called Titans. Conflicts occurred between the Titans and the Gods, and the war began when Prometheus stole the fire from Olympus. Atlas, who pioneered the Titans in this war, was punished by the Gods for carrying the world on this shoulders when he lost the war. Atlas's symbolism of carrying the world on his shoulders has been an inspiration for many literary stories.

Atlante Nero Crystal Candle Holder is home to 100% soy wax and Leone di Fiume's signature perfume unique to this product.

Scent Profile

Charm the air around you with creamy notes of tonka beans and a touch of caramel. Heart notes reveal mandarine and ylang-ylang, creating euphoria. At the base notes, warm and sensual sandalwood blends with musk to reveal a mesmerizing harmony.

The exquisite work of art is presented in a luxuriant handmade wooden chest.
